Polished Website Builder v0.1.0

- Initial release of the skill for building responsive, locally editable websites from product or service descriptions.
- Delivers actual HTML/CSS/JS files and assets, suitable for landing pages, demos, and small showcase sites.
- Emphasizes local use: no deployment, backend services, or hosting workflow included.
- Requires JishuDB for storing knowledge, revisions, and sources.
- Includes clear instructions for capability checks, file generation, source retention, and user approval flows.
- Outputs site files, source attribution, revision record, and user guidance documentation per project.
